name: Classmate 2
source:
A classmate who's close to Mizu and Classmate 1. The three of them are usually seem hanging out together.

She's often scolded by Classmate 1 due to her laid-back personality.

Went to the same elementary school as the protagonist, and was even in the same class as him.

[Translated from the [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160401085609/http://www.sakuramint.net/tsugiteras/tsugi_chara.htm]official website[/url]]
